notes: Schedule 1-A Part V line 33: line 31 (MAGI, which is AGI itself for the bounded supported class with no Puerto Rico/2555/4563 amounts -- line 31 reads AGI directly, no separate rule) minus line 32's threshold (tax.us.2025.parameter.senior-deduction-magi-threshold: $75,000, $150,000 if married filing jointly -- f1040s1a-2025 line 32; i1040gi-2025 p.109). Not floored at zero here -- the form's own line 33 can be negative or zero; line 34 is the one that floors at zero before multiplying by the rate, so '$6,000 on line 35' when line 33 is zero or less falls out of line 34 publishing 0, not out of this rule.
